name: What's Uphouse?
guessed: the house is 3x3 with a 1x1 hollow interior; the back and sides are assumed symmetric and hidden
the coloured roof is a 3x3x3 checker of yellow/orange/red concrete with a single orange block on top; the exact checker order is read from the front and repeated on the sides
the front is open at the centre with a spruce plank door frame on the right side; the three small blue panes in the frame are too small to read as blocks and are left out
the lower band is read as coarse dirt and the upper band as bricks
the base is a 5x5 dirt platform with an oak-plank interior floor
the four floor panels are read as sea lanterns (bright cyan with a border); diamond block is possible
the roof size and the 9-layer height are estimated from the render; the build is seen from the front only
